server.description: Era4’s project in Canterbury, Kent, United Kingdom has received an approval.

haiku.description: Era4 has received planning permission from Canterbury City Council for an AI data center at Shelford Landfill in Kent. Power would come mainly through a private wire from the nearby Valencia Energy Center, which runs on landfill gas.

server.description: Project update: Freedom Separation Plant (Phoenix Tailings, Inc.), Rochester, N.Y., United States · USD 1200M

haiku.capacity: More than 18,000 tons per year of feedstock; more than 4,400 tons per year of separated rare earth oxides
haiku.description: Phoenix Tailings has chosen a Rochester, New York site at Eastman Business Park for its Freedom Separation rare earth plant, part of a $1.2 billion-plus project. The plant aims to output over 4,400 tons of separated oxides yearly, ramping up from 2027.

server.description: Tender issued: Floating Solar-Plus-Storage Project (Rwanda Energy Corporation), Rwanda

haiku.description: Rwanda's Energy Development Corporation has invited independent power producers to bid on a floating solar project paired with battery storage. The site is Lake Sake in Ngoma District, Eastern Province, and bids are due November 12, 2026.

server.description: Eastern Pacific Shipping's Terra Clove is the first ammonia dual-fuelled vessel registered in Singapore.

haiku.description: Project update: Terra Clove (Eastern Pacific Shipping), HD Hyundai Heavy Industries, Ulsan, South Korea

server.description: Lavinia Bulkers has ordered four Newcastlemax vessels in China, valued at $312 million.

haiku.description: Lavinia Bulkers is reportedly behind an order for four 212,000 dwt newcastlemax bulkers at Zhoushan Changhong, valued near $312m. Deliveries are scheduled for 2030, according to shipbroking sources cited in the report.

server.description: OEG Marine Services has ordered three crew transfer vessels for its offshore wind fleet expansion.

haiku.capacity: Three crew transfer vessels, 26 m length each
haiku.description: Order placed: Offshore Wind CTVs Order (OEG Marine Services), Diverse Marine, Cowes, Isle of Wight, United Kingdom

server.description: Investors have taken FID for a new gas play that will supply an LNG facility in Nigeria.

haiku.description: The project is a Nigerian gas development meant to feed an LNG plant, and its backers have approved the final investment decision. The page is paywalled, so volumes, costs and partners are not shown.

server.description: A utility-scale gas-to-power plant in Lagos is undergoing a major upgrade to double its capacity.

haiku.description: Project update: Gas Plant Upgrade, Lagos, Nigeria

server.description: Valero completed a $230 million upgrade of the FCC unit at its St. Charles refinery.

haiku.description: Valero finished its $230-million FCC unit optimization at the St. Charles refinery in Louisiana on schedule and on budget. The upgrade lifts gasoline and alkylate output, per its third-quarter 2026 earnings release.

project: Southeast Connector and Permian Link Pipelines

server.description: Kinder Morgan has taken FID on two natural gas pipelines to add 5.4 bcfd capacity by 2030.

haiku.owner: Kinder Morgan Inc. (via Southern Natural Gas and Natural Gas Pipeline Co. of America)
haiku.description: Kinder Morgan's subsidiaries reached final investment decisions on Southeast Connector, a 2.6 bcfd, 470-mile line costing $3.1 billion, and Permian Link, 2.8 bcfd costing $4.2 billion.

server.description: Yinson Production and PTSC have achieved first oil at a floating storage and offloading vessel project in Vietnam.

haiku.owner: Yinson Production and PetroVietnam Technical Services Corporation (joint venture)
haiku.description: Delivered / commissioned: FSO Vessel Project (Yinson Production and PetroVietnam Technical Services Corporation (joint v

server.description: Aker BP and Höegh Evi secured EU funding for the Atlas CCS project in Norway.

haiku.capacity: Up to 6 million tonnes/year of CO2
haiku.description: Financing agreed: Atlas CCS Project (Aker BP; Höegh Evi), EXL011 license, Norwegian North Sea, Norway

project: North Field West Offshore Expansion Project

server.description: A tender has been issued for QatarEnergy’s project in Qatar. Capacity 16 MTPA. Value USD 40bn. Contractors: COOEC (EPC); L&T (EPC).

haiku.description: Final stage of QatarEnergy's North Field LNG expansion, adding offshore gas supply for new Ras Laffan processing. COOEC, L&T, McDermott and Saipem are bidding on an offshore deck-module package; technical bids close October 12, 2026.

server.description: Kuwait Gulf Oil Company is advancing the Dorra Gas Field project with a $3.3 billion tender.

haiku.capacity: 632 million cubic feet of gas per day; about 60,000 barrels per day of condensate
haiku.description: Kuwait Gulf Oil Company's estimated $3.3 billion plant beside Al-Zour will process Dorra field gas and condensate. The page reports an August 2026 tender and a site-preparation award to Ahmadiah Contracting.

server.description: ADNOC Offshore’s project in Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates is on our tracker. Capacity 390,000 barrels per day. Value USD 2bn.

haiku.description: ADNOC Offshore's LTDP-2.1 expansion at Umm Shaif in Abu Dhabi is nearing its main EPC tender. The page reports planned early contractor engagement, a June 2026 expression-of-interest for two EPC packages, and no disclosed cost.

server.description: Financing has been agreed for Deriva Energy’s project in Sullivan County, Indiana, United States (USD 540M). Capacity 350 MW.

haiku.owner: Deriva Energy (a Brookfield Renewable portfolio company)
haiku.description: Deriva Energy has closed a roughly $540 million financing for the 350 MW Sullivan County solar project under construction in Indiana. The page reports the deal, arranged by Deriva's capital markets team with its lenders and external advisors.

server.description: Outokumpu Corp. partnered with Jennmar to supply ground control tools for the Kemi mine.

haiku.capacity: 2.7 million tons per year ore processing
haiku.description: Outokumpu's Kemi chrome mine in Finland will receive ground-control equipment from Jennmar under a multi-year agreement. The page reports the partnership, covering bolting products, mesh and resins, supported by a new Jennmar Finland unit.

project: Fuel Purchase Authorization for Moa Nickel

server.description: Sherritt International received U.S. Treasury authorization for fuel purchases for its Moa Nickel operations.

haiku.description: Sherritt International received a US OFAC license for fuel, fuel oil and sulfur deliveries to its Moa Nickel operations in Cuba. The page reports it is the first of several licenses needed to restart mining, with a shipment expected in Q4 2026.

server.description: An equipment or vessel order was placed for MISC Berhad’s project in China. Contractors: Hudong-Zhonghua Shipbuilding (yard).

haiku.description: Malaysia's MISC has placed an order with Hudong-Zhonghua for a batch of 174,000 cbm gas carriers, after earlier orders of three and two ships this year. The yard's LNG carrier orderbook now totals 57 vessels.

server.description: Seven Yield’s project in China is on our tracker.

haiku.description: Seven Yield has signed five-year time charters with a major Chinese automaker for two LNG dual-fuel PCTC vessels. The page reports the agreement dated 22 October 2026, while full terms sit behind a membership paywall.

server.description: The project in Poland has received an approval.

haiku.description: Poland's gas TSO Gaz-System has finished driving more than 500 piles for the jetty of the planned FSRU terminal in Gdansk Bay. The page reports the milestone was completed on schedule and on budget, with the first vessel targeted for early 2028.

server.description: A contract for DOF Group’s project in Africa has been awarded, valued at USD 25M.

haiku.description: Contract awarded: DOF Subsea Installation Contract (DOF Group), Offshore Africa · USD 15-25M · DOF Group +1

server.description: A contract for Wisting partnership’s project in Norway has been awarded to Aibel (FEED).

haiku.owner: Wisting partnership: Equinor Energy AS, Aker BP ASA, Petoro AS, INPEX Idemitsu Norge AS
haiku.description: Aibel has been awarded the front-end engineering and design contract for the topsides of Wisting's production vessel after a competitive tender. The Wisting partnership expects a concept selection decision toward the end of 2026.
